roles.source: Maintained implementation or validation method; removal requires caller and behavioral coverage.
roles.reference: Original source evidence or provenance; retain exact source bytes.
roles.knowledge: Intent, requirements, methodology, decisions, lessons, limitations, or future work; retained location records ownership.
roles.evidence: Measured verification or review evidence; coverage and limitations remain with the record.
roles.deliverable: Generated model, drawing, preview, or illustration serving a documented inspection/export role.
roles.repository: Existing repository history and metadata, retained intact.
roles.dependency: Pinned, reproducible dependency installation; one central installation replaces three.
roles.cache: Disposable reproducible cache, scratch download, or installation log.

referenceAnalysis: Mentions are resolved literal references in the checkpoint, including documentation. Dynamic resources and semantic consumers were checked through the object resource maps, builds, runtime fingerprints, and browser/geometry verification; no-mention status never authorized deletion.

concurrentRevision.scope: User-authorized anatomy v2 rebuild; independent of the geometry-preserving folder migration. V1 methods, limitations, notes and artifacts remain reconstructable.
